question: Can published PSR reproduce the known harbor prompt effect internally on the exact local Q2 GGUF host?
result: No faithful PSR coordinate was executable against the exact Q2 llama.cpp host. No model calls were made.

boundaries.reason: Stage-0 incompatibility established before construction or inference.

requirements_observed: Hugging Face PyTorch PreTrainedModel and tokenizer
model.get_submodule and register_forward_hook at selected layers
prompted and intervened model.forward residual streams
loss.backward through frozen host downstream computation
dynamic per-token learned location projection during generation
published_method.module_parameters: per selected layer: steering H-to-1 projection plus location-fit H-to-1 projection, with optional scalar bias

incompatibility.conclusion: A static cvector is not PSR; a custom differentiable capture and dynamic intervention ABI is required for exact-Q2 PSR.

resource_assessment.local_6gib_result: insufficient for an autograd-enabled BF16 4B transformer host; weights alone are approximately 8 GB before training activations
resource_assessment.smallest_credible_separate_prototype: 24 GiB single GPU, short context and batch 1, frozen HF host, explicit gradient/memory handling
resource_assessment.qualification_caveat: An HF prototype is a different host representation and requires an explicit comparability qualification before it can be used to make claims about exact Q2 llama.cpp.

historical_calibration.known_positive_text_condition: Forced consideration of the harbor association visibly engaged harbor/tide/docking structure.
